summary: @or-sdk/content-request preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which fetches the Bun runtime binary from a hardcoded GitHub release URL, extracts and chmods it, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is ~727KB, single-line, and heavily obfuscated: a large string-array (`n7gIxM`), a rotation function (`WV8StW`), and a custom base-alphabet decoder (`hc1jfK9`) hide its real behavior behind a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, and its filename does not correspond to the package's advertised content-request SDK purpose. `setup.mjs` itself is written in obfuscator.io-style form with hex-named identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and per-call string-lookup objects, further concealing the download-and-exec chain. On `npm install`, the alternate Bun runtime is used to execute the opaque payload outside the Node inspection surface, giving the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
